named_subject: ocean waves drawn as a stack of zigzag and wavy lines
action: The stack of wave lines rises, widens and drifts right while the top wave builds a tall peak at its right end, and the lower lines slide down out of frame as a horizon line appears at the top.
identity_gap: From frame 6 on, the character has the same four wave strokes and the small zigzag tick as the doodle, but in frames 1-5 the top stroke has only one hump and the zigzag tick is missing, so it is not yet the same drawing.
notes: The animation matches the film in tilting up to a horizon line at the end, but the film's rolling and breaking waves show up only as the whole drawing sliding, and in frames 3 and 5 the strokes rearrange in a jump. The change that would help most is to keep the full doodle (both humps and the zigzag tick) from frame 1 and make the waves rise and roll in place instead of having strokes appear or regroup.
